title: A request stores a relation: what survives a rename
goal: Write a request with references, rename its customer and reread the same document to verify relationship and minutes.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P3. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: A request must identify which customer ordered the service. Their name changes today. Check whether the request needs rewriting to show the new name and what must stay unchanged.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: A reference is not an edit buffer
paragraphs: A reference identifies an item; obtaining its object provides editable state. Changing an object field in memory does not prove persistence. Two objects may reflect different read times. Do not save a stale object after another change without an agreed conflict strategy.

The function creates a synthetic customer, service and 30-minute request, storing references in the document. Renaming the same customer should preserve the request’s customer identity and 30 minutes. Reading Клиент.Наименование should display the new name. These are three separate claims, not one visual comparison.

sections.title: The complete function: what happens to the data
paragraphs: УчебныеДанные common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.
This is Данные.bsl for the common module. The separate application source below calls it. Do not paste both files into one editor.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: The document stores customer and service references rather than copied captions. After renaming the customer, reread the same document: its reference and 30 minutes should remain, while the customer name comes from the related record.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

sections.title: An empty reference is not an unknown string
paragraphs: A typed empty reference differs fromUndefined and an empty-name string. Existence checks follow the API and business rule. FindByCode does not create an absent item. Handle absence beforeGetObject so diagnostics identify the missing customer rather than a later incidental error.

An empty reference is a value of a specific reference type, not Undefined or empty text. Our ПередЗаписью requires customer, service and status. A name string is not a substitute for a reference. Inspect the selected entity and the application’s empty-value rule first.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: The customer is renamed without replacing the request’s reference. Which name will a fresh read through the customer reference return?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: The new name. The relation still points to that customer record; it is not the old name copied into the document. A historical caption as of a date requires a separate design.

sections.title: Attribute reads have a cost
paragraphs: Reference access looks simple, but mass traversal can cause many calls. An object suits one card; reports across many rows often need a query selecting required fields. Do not infer performance from code appearance: count calls and measure equal datasets first. P7 examines queries in detail.

This request stores no historical snapshot of the customer name. Its current presentation can change after renaming the item. A task needing an immutable name as of a document date requires separate attributes/versioning and rules. Do not infer that history from a reference; the course uses no real documents or third-party configuration.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: The arrows preserve the request’s relation to α while the related record’s caption changes. In the independent task you will replace the service relation explicitly, which requires assignment and saving the document.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: Looking up by name instead of keeping the reference can pick another customer with that name. Compare freshly read document references with the specific references you preserved; matching names do not replace that check.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Persistence needs a fresh read
paragraphs: Find an item, change its name through the object, write it and obtain a fresh object. Compare identity and value. Test an absent code without implicit creation. Preserve before/after snapshots and verify a linked request still references the same customer.

The tested incorrect variant writes 31 instead of 30 minutes. It compiles and retains the correct relationship, but fails the independent duration expectation. Reference verification does not cover other fields. Every call creates a new customer/service/document set: run once and remove the startup call afterward.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: Create a new 45-minute request for a new training customer and service A, then save it. Replace the service on that same document with new service B and save again. Rename B and reread the request: show the same document and customer, B instead of A, preserved 45 minutes, and B’s new name.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.

sections.title: Where to run it and what to observe in 1C
paragraphs: УчебныеДанные common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.

Preserve the previous handler separately. Run the experiment once in your copy, compare labelled messages and specific new records, then remove only the added startup call. Do not delete records to match a screenshot.

paragraphs: The chosen training path is checked in a file infobase. This does not establish all permissions, bulk changes, network-server behaviour, or learner understanding. A run, a saved completion mark, and an explanation are separate facts.
